C.label: full saved history with native continuation guards

P.label: explicit reviewed projected input with fresh recovery and first-input guards

session_policy.source_facts: empty isolated store per source; clone settled resulting facts identically per arm

followup_message: Continue the original bounded task. Preserve existing work and all original requirements; inspect current instructions and code, run the configured check after edits, and report actual checks and unresolved limits.

span_policy.paths: exact task allowed_modified_paths in declared order
span_policy.missing_deleted_nontext_or_unavailable: projected arm blocked; no substitution or dropped span

source_disposition: Source completed and independently accepted: both workflows succeed at source, no followups, arms not-needed. Otherwise both predeclared arms count; structural refusal is blocked, not omitted.
staging_policy: One frozen literal owned canonical root/inode. Preserve every artifact and eligible file/type/mode proof before any replacement. Closed source SQLite/fact images cloned independently per arm without rewriting records; stop on unknown/unsettled work. Never reset user checkout.
stop_all_policy: Provider/transport/unknown usage, changed model/runtime/environment/criteria, unsettled cleanup, external mutation or invalid preservation proof: stop remaining rows, retain failed/blocked/unrun states, no replacement/fallback/repair.

primary_metric: completed and independently accepted workflow: source success OR own followup success; source shared but charged to both policy workflows
conditional_rescue_metric: completed-and-accepted followups / all sources needing recovery, including structural blocked arms; distinguish already-accepted partial source artifacts from patch repair
execution_gate: No generation from protocol merge. Require offline paired staging/client preflight, clean pinned runtime/model/environment, exact reviewed merged execution freeze, parent approval receipt and fresh launch gates for each named phase.
